concerns.location: tasks.md:Inputs + T001/T007 vs spec.md:FR-001, FR-004, SC-000, SC-002, SC-003, SC-005
concerns.text: Tasks deliver simulated stand-ins for requirements the spec still mandates against real Uni-GUI logs and real UI-MOPD policy heads. The plan flags the mismatch 'for spec correction', but the spec was never amended, so T001 (synthetic generator tagged FR-001) and T007 (simulated heads/baseline tagged FR-004/SC-002/SC-003) silently relax unsanctioned MUSTs. The spec must be revised to sanction the simulation scope before tasks can claim these FRs/SCs.

FR-002 states absolute thresholds (AUC-ROC ≥ 0.80, Brier ≤ 0.20) the system MUST meet; T004 reframes them as 'reported relative to a shuffled-label null control' and explicitly plans regimes where thresholds are NOT met. This is a semantic weakening of a MUST adopted without spec amendment — the anti-circularity design is sound, but the spec text must be updated to authorize the relative-to-null framing.

T001 adds a 'noise_feature' control column to the generated records while the schema declares additionalProperties: false, and simultaneously requires the test to assert schema conformance. As written these are mutually exclusive; either the schema must permit the control field or the control feature must live in a separate artifact.

T007/T008 depend on validating the PolicyHead manifest and AdapterModelOutput entity, and the data model declares contracts/policy_head.schema.yaml and contracts/adapter_output.schema.yaml, but neither schema file exists. No task creates them, so the contract-validation constraint has no implementing task.

Plan places code under 'src/', 'tests/', 'specs/001-gui-topology-transfer/'; tasks use 'code/src/', 'code/tests/', 'specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-ui-mopd-mult/'. The constitution requires code under 'code/', so tasks are likely correct, but the plan/tasks path divergence makes verification paths untraceable — reconcile the plan.

Plan Phase 1 includes an 'a-priori power note for detecting ΔAUC = 0.05 with three predictors under Bonferroni correction', but no task produces this power-analysis artifact — a plan component with no implementing task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 vs plan.md:Constitution Check Principle IV
concerns.text: Plan Principle IV names 'data/derived/structural_records.csv' as the single source of truth; T001 writes the cleaned dataset to 'data/derived/structural_records_clean.csv'. Minor naming inconsistency that breaks the declared traceability anchor.

FR-004 requires policy heads 'stored in a version-controlled artifact repository'; T007 only generates them under local 'data/artifacts/policy_heads/' with checksums. The version-controlled-repository clause is not addressed by any task — either satisfy it (e.g., committed artifacts with recorded hashes per Principle V) or have the spec revision explicitly scope it down.
